description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Anarchist, adding {C}{C}.
When Anarchist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Anarchist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Anarchist from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Anarchist and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Anarchist triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Anarchist trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
